title: Better Spruce Doors
description: Fixes the mismatch between Spruce Doors and Trapdoors
body:
Love building with Spruce?
**Better Spruce Doors** updates the door texture to align perfectly with Spruce Trapdoors. A clean, **Vanilla+** tweak!

![Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02ce24b2d663ef49ebfef6201e16ae61837b1544.png)

The texture is made with two spruce trapdoors textures and some modifications to fit in seamlessly  

Tested from 1.19 +
